name: agent-comic
description: A little comic above the prompt: Claude acts out what the agent is doing in animated pixel scenes, from a home hub with keepsakes

director.title: Director
director.description: Who stages the scenes: hybrid (the model sets up each turn and wraps it up; everything in between is canned, so few tokens), full (the model stages every scene), or off (canned scenes only, no tokens).

model.title: Director model
model.description: Which model stages the scenes: sonnet (richer) or haiku (cheaper).

pace.title: Pace
pace.description: How busy Claude is: calm (long pauses), normal, or lively (quick and frequent scenes).

showWhenIdle.title: Show when idle
showWhenIdle.description: Keep the comic up between turns (Claude idles and dozes off). Off: only while Claude works.
